records.public_claim_text: 7 2.1.1 Evaluation protocol design principles The most important principle of evaluation protocol design is that procedures should be designed to support the objectives of the evaluation (Practice 1.1).

records.public_claim_text: That said, there are common design principles that can help guide protocol design for a broad range of evaluation objectives.

records.public_claim_text: For example, the evaluator may want to use a protocol that provides models with tools and information comparable to those used in existing baselines.

records.public_claim_text: In many cases, the objective of an evaluation is to gain information on how a model or system will behave in certain external contexts (e.g., real-world, worstcase, best-case, hypothetical) different from that of the evaluation.
